tool.title: Transcribe audio — vosk (option, not installed)
tool.description: Transcribe an audio file with vosk (Kaldi-based), offline, from Python, with small per-language models. A declared OPTION: not installed in this repository.

install.cli: pip install vosk, plus a per-language model (small ≈ 40–50 MB)

selection.when: When size and speed matter more than accuracy: the lightest offline option, with a separate small model per language.
selection.limits: Noticeably lower accuracy than the Whisper family on varied recordings; one model per language to fetch and keep.
selection.cost: Not installed. Small wheel; ≈ 40–50 MB per language model.
